 Responsibilities
 Design, document, execute, and maintain functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test scenarios.
 Identify suitable manual test scenarios for automation and continuously expand automated test coverage.
 Develop and maintain automated test frameworks, test utilities, and test scenarios using C# or JavaScript.
 Integrate automated tests into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and analyze automated test results.
 Validate new features, bug fixes, and application changes against functional and technical requirements.
 Perform API testing and validate data flows between application components and external systems.
 Use SQL queries to validate application data, investigate defects, and verify expected system behavior.
 Identify, document, track, and retest defects, providing clear information that helps development teams reproduce and resolve issues.
 Collaborate with Developers and Product Owners during requirements analysis to identify risks, edge cases, and testability concerns early.
 Contribute to improving testing standards, automation frameworks, test data, and QA processes.
 Support investigation of production incidents and contribute to root-cause analysis where appropriate.
 Use approved AI-assisted tools to improve test design, automation, troubleshooting, and QA productivity while validating generated output and maintaining quality standards.
 Qualifications
 At least 3 years of professional experience in software quality assurance and testing.
 Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated tests for web applications.
 Good programming skills in C# or JavaScript, with the ability to develop and maintain test automation code.
 Experience with at least one modern test automation framework such as Playwright, Selenium, or similar.
 Good understanding of functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.
 Experience testing REST APIs using tools or automated frameworks.
 Good knowledge of SQL and experience validating data directly in relational databases.
 Experience with test management, defect tracking, and collaborative development workflows.
 Experience working with Git and version-controlled test automation projects.
 Understanding of CI/CD concepts and experience running automated tests as part of build or deployment pipelines.
 Good understanding of web technologies, client-server architecture, and distributed applications.
 Ability to analyze requirements and translate them into clear and maintainable test scenarios.
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
 Ability to work independently on moderately complex testing and automation tasks.
